reserveReview.rationale: Fresh pinned reads at Ethereum block 26296822 (hash 0xd9a1213a6ee74b12106e77b6293c317a268a6669fb7609eda8465214559875c6, timestamp 2026-10-29T07:12:23Z): sDOLA is not an EIP-1967 proxy; savings() is the DOLA Savings Account 0xe5f24791e273cb96a1f8e5b67bc2397f0ad9b8b4 and asset() is DOLA 0x865377367054516e17014ccded1e7d814edc9ce4. totalAssets() is 19,472,324.14535532527266491 DOLA and the vault's own DOLA balance is 0, so 100% of totalAssets() is staked in DolaSavings. The exact pinned sDola.sol implementation stakes deposits into DolaSavings and totalAssets() measures its DOLA balance less undistributed weekly revenue; beforeWithdraw() unstakes DOLA atomically while retaining MIN_BALANCE and MIN_SHARES. The issuer describes instant permissionless DOLA unwrapping with no lock-up. This review identifies the parent DOLA stablecoin claim; it does not establish same-notional USD liquidation.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: At Ethereum block 26095807, savings() identifies the DOLA Savings Account and asset() identifies DOLA. The pinned source stakes deposits in that account and unstakes withdrawals. Inverse states that deposits are not rehypothecated or loaned to third parties. No enforceable legal segregation, bankruptcy-remoteness, or anti-rehypothecation terms were established, so those safeguards remain unknown. Governance retains the source-documented sweep function for ERC-20 balances in the wrapper other than DBR.
